_doc: ERSI backgrounds catalogue, the single source for every background.usda a run loads: scripts/build_backgrounds.py renders ALL entries into a scratch tree (default /tmp/ersibench/background) that run_benchmark.sh and run_data_collection.sh mount over /geniesim_assets/background before every run. Entries with `source` were imported from the upstream scene of that name and `build_backgrounds.py --check` (ersi env) fails unless they still compose identically to it. See the script docstring for the fields.
